statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-125350 is a use after free in XML handling, fixed in Google Chrome 157.0.8103.50: https://issues.chromium.org/issues/582442907 . The bug is in libxslt: xsltTestCompMatchDirect in libxslt/pattern.c frees a cached node-set that a nested evaluation of the same pattern may already have freed. The Chromium fix, 'Fix use-after-free in libxslt direct pattern match cache', names that issue: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/c/chromium/src/+/8762073 . Alpine backported it to libxslt as 1.1.43-r4 on 3.23, see https://security.alpinelinux.org/vuln/CVE-2026-125350 and https://gitlab.alpinelinux.org/alpine/aports/-/raw/8b367fdee54989e3f08a4ce2153d3ad2d25ce42b/main/libxslt/APKBUILD . The DHI repository publishes libxslt 1.1.43-r3 and 1.1.43-r4 for Alpine 3.23; 1.1.43-r4 is built from that recipe revision, and 1.1.43-r3 predates the backport. We checked the libxslt and libxslt-static packages of both builds on x86_64 and aarch64, each against its index checksum. In libxslt.a, pattern.o's xsltTestCompMatch, into which xsltTestCompMatchDirect is inlined, grows from 2083 to 2088 bytes on x86_64 and from 1992 to 2000 bytes on aarch64, and it is the only function in pattern.o that changes; the other patches added in 1.1.43-r4 do not touch pattern.c. The matching function in libxslt.so.1.1.43 grows by the same 5 and 8 bytes.
